title: Basketball Legends 8
about: BASKETBALL LEGENDS 8: one on one, from 1960 to forever, the 8-bit side of Basketball Legend. Written in Sprout. Build your player and beat a legend of every decade to 11.
line: The 8-bit side of Basketball Legend, in an arcade cabinet: one on one from 1960 to forever, jump shots let go at the top of the jump, dunks, crossovers and blocks, a legend for every decade.
